tickets.title: Layout setting and the Inbox layout
tickets.what:
`docs/spec.md` §2.2 "Panel layouts" (owner, 2026-11-17). Option 1 · Inbox of
`docs/design/panel-v8/` (`options.html` frames, `notes.md` "Option 1 · Inbox"), built as drawn, selectable beside
today's layout.

acceptance.text: Settings → Panel → Layout: Classic (default, today's Home and Project unchanged), Inbox, Split (Split shows Classic until ticket 02 lands). Saved like the other Settings rows; the panel switches without a restart.

Inbox Home as drawn: one list ranked by need (question, failure, stalled, report ready, running), a job is its title row plus one sentence row while it runs or when it went wrong, the package as the title's first word (dim `PKG ›` prefix when the title does not start with it), the waiting row (busy: a count, Enter lists them; idle: all of them), decisions folded to `▸ N as proposed` with departures kept, the compact progress block, and the 40 × 24 give-way order from notes.md.

Inbox Project as drawn: the hub's `Waiting for you` holds STATE's items and the to-try slices once, `y`/`n` work on its rows (same records as PANEL-TRY), Latest lists accepted slices, `In flight`, page rows with marks; Progress puts `To try` above `Now`; `t` does nothing in Inbox.
Classic is byte-identical to today (existing frame snapshots unchanged).
Frame tests for Inbox Home busy/idle/24 rows and the Inbox hub and Progress on synthetic data; snapshots added with `npm run snapshots:update`.

tickets.title: Keep Split, delete Inbox; mark several rows, one try record
tickets.what:
`docs/spec.md` §2.2 (owner, 2026-11-18): the owner kept Split; Inbox is deleted, Classic stays the
default. The owner can mark several to-try rows and record them with one `y`/`n`, so the main session hears one line.

Legacy Blocked by: none (in parallel with 04; see Comments)

acceptance.text: Delete Inbox: `src/render/inbox-*.ts`, its branches in work-view.ts, project-view.ts and workboard-input.ts, its tests and fixtures (`inbox-layout`, `inbox-live`, `tests/fixtures/inbox*`), its snapshot writer, its i18n strings, its docs (reference.md, reference.zh.md "Panel layouts", ARCHITECTURE §6). The setting keeps `classic | split`; a saved `inbox` value reads as `classic`. Settings help names only Classic and Split. Exports Split still imports stay; drop the `export` keyword where only Inbox used it.

Mark several: on Classic's Progress to-try view and on Split's To try rows (hub preview and Progress page), Space toggles a mark on the cursor row (a visible mark glyph); `y`/`n` with marks present records all marked slices as one record in `$HUD_HOME/tries.jsonl` (`slices: [...]`) and clears the marks; with no marks `y`/`n` act on the cursor row as today. Leaving the view clears the marks. Help and the footer name Space.
`hud watch` and MCP `changes` print one line per record (check it already joins several slices; fix if not).
Tests: one frame test that Split and Classic are unchanged by the deletion apart from the Settings row; one that Space-mark-mark-`y` writes one record with both slices and one watch line.

tickets.title: What the owner tries is never cut; a model brief and acceptance steps
tickets.what:
`docs/spec.md` §2.2 (owner, 2026-11-18): opening the to-try slices and the waiting items, the owner
saw only short names, cut even when the panel had empty rows, and could not tell what they were accepting.

Legacy Blocked by: none (in parallel with 03; see Comments)

acceptance.text: Whole text: a to-try slice row (Classic's Progress to-try view, Split's hub To try and Progress page) and a waiting item show their whole text (ledger line after the ID; STATE's waiting item), wrapped, wherever the panel has the rows. Where rows are short, the cursor row keeps its whole text and the others give way first. Split's preview of the cursor slice shows its whole text.

Model on (the existing master switch, model and call cap; pattern: `src/collectors/job-sentences.ts`, `src/collectors/small-model.ts`): per to-try slice, one call makes a short brief (what changed, in plain words, at most 2 sentences) and acceptance steps (how to try it, at most 4 short steps), in the panel's language, from its ledger line, the subjects and bodies of commits named in it (at most 5) and the ticket files under a `.scratch/<slug>/` it names (capped). Cached per slice by a hash of those inputs, so an unchanged slice costs no call. Shown in Split's preview of the cursor slice and in Classic when the to-try row is expanded (Enter), above the original text; a pending or failed call shows the original text only.
Model off: the original text, whole, as above. No call.

Tests: frame tests at 40 columns that a long to-try line and a long waiting item wrap instead of being cut (Classic and Split); one that a cached brief and steps render in Split's preview and Classic's expanded row; one that the model off makes no call. Synthetic data only.
